description: This PHP source file defines the class Openads_Schema_Manager, which manages database schema operations such as creating, comparing, updating, and finalizing database schema files, including handling transitional states, validation, and migration class generation within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: Openads_Schema_Manager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing database schema files, including creation, comparison, validation, transitional states, and migration class generation for the Revive Adserver project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the schema manager, setting paths, loading schema definitions, and preparing the MDB2_Schema object.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new database schema XML file with a specified name.

methods.name: createChangeset
methods.description: Generates a changeset XML by comparing current and previous schema definitions.

methods.name: saveChangeset
methods.description: Saves a changeset from an input file, possibly rewriting it.

methods.name: createTransitional
methods.description: Creates transitional schema and links files for editing.

methods.name: commitFinal
methods.description: Finalizes transitional files, copying them to final locations and creating associated changesets.

methods.name: _getNextVersion
methods.description: Calculates the next version number for schema files.

methods.name: _getBasename
methods.description: Generates a basename for schema files based on the filename and version.

methods.name: setWorkingFiles
methods.description: Sets the working schema and links files for editing.

methods.name: parseWorkingDefinitionFile
methods.description: Parses the current working schema file into an internal array.

methods.name: writeWorkingDefinitionFile
methods.description: Writes the current schema definition array to a file.

methods.name: deleteTransitional
methods.description: Deletes transitional schema and links files.

methods.name: deleteLinksTrans
methods.description: Deletes transitional links file.

methods.name: deleteChangesTrans
methods.description: Deletes transitional changeset file.

methods.name: deleteSchemaTrans
methods.description: Deletes transitional schema file.

methods.name: fieldSave
methods.description: Validates and updates a table field, cascading changes to indexes and links.

methods.name: fieldAdd
methods.description: Adds a new field to a table and validates the schema.

methods.name: fieldDelete
methods.description: Removes a field from a table and updates related indexes and links.

methods.name: fieldWasSave
methods.description: Stores a 'was' property for a field in a changeset.

methods.name: tableWasSave
methods.description: Stores a 'was' property for a table in a changeset.

methods.name: indexDelete
methods.description: Removes an index from a table.

methods.name: indexAdd
methods.description: Adds an index to a table.

methods.name: indexSave
methods.description: Validates and updates an index definition.

methods.name: tableNew
methods.description: Creates a new table schema.

methods.name: tableDelete
methods.description: Deletes a table schema.

methods.name: tableSave
methods.description: Updates a table schema and cascades changes.

methods.name: linkDelete
methods.description: Removes a link from the schema.

methods.name: linkAdd
methods.description: Adds a link to the schema.

methods.name: readForeignKeys
methods.description: Reads foreign key references for a table.

methods.name: getLinkTargets
methods.description: Builds an array of link cross-references.

methods.name: validate_table
methods.description: Validates table properties.

methods.name: validate_field
methods.description: Validates field properties.

methods.name: validate_index
methods.description: Validates index properties.

methods.name: updateFieldIndexRelations
methods.description: Updates index relations after a field change.

methods.name: updateFieldLinkRelations
methods.description: Updates link relations after a field change.

methods.name: deleteTableLinkRelations
methods.description: Removes link relations for a deleted table.

methods.name: updateTableLinkRelations
methods.description: Updates link relations after a table rename.

methods.name: init_schema_validator
methods.description: Initializes the schema validation object.

methods.name: writeMigrationClass
methods.description: Generates a migration PHP class based on a changeset.

methods.name: _buildBuffers
methods.description: Builds task and method buffers for migration class.

methods.name: _buildTask
methods.description: Creates code to add a task to the migration class.

methods.name: _buildMap
methods.description: Creates code for object mapping in migration.

methods.name: _buildMethod
methods.description: Creates code for a migration class method.

methods.name: testChangeset
methods.description: Debug method to compare and dump changeset differences.

methods.name: _generateDataObjects
methods.description: Rebuilds data object classes based on schema changes.

methods.name: commitFinalXMLRPC
methods.description: Registers schema version via XML-RPC, finalizes files.

methods.name: _getNextVersionXMLRPC
methods.description: Gets the next version number via XML-RPC.

methods.name: _registerVersion
methods.description: Registers a schema version with the XML-RPC server.
